remarks:
Country charm meets everyday comfort in this inviting 3-bedroom, 1-bath home located in the desirable Oakfield-Alabama School District! From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the peaceful setting and the space this property offers both inside and out.
Step inside to find a warm and welcoming layout featuring two generously sized bedrooms, providing plenty of room to spread out and make yourself at home. The large mudroom/laundry room offers the perfect drop zone for boots, coats, and everything that comes with country living.
Outside is where this property truly shines. With two large garages, two separate driveways, and a spacious covered patio tucked behind one of the garages, you'll have endless possibilities for entertaining, relaxing, hobbies, storage, or workshop space. Picture summer evenings spent under the covered patio, enjoying the fresh air and quiet surroundings.
This home has been thoughtfully updated with newer siding, newer carpeting, furnace 5 years young, hot water tank 3, many newer windows and doors and a durable metal roof that's only 6 years old, offering both charm and peace of mind. Whether you're looking for your first home, a place to slow down and enjoy small-town living, or simply need extra garage space, this property is full of potential and ready for its next chapter.
Don't miss your opportunity to enjoy the simple pleasures of country living while still being conveniently located near everything you need!
